title: Nebula RUM release health
description: Per-release session health aggregate (v1). A session counts as crashed when it carries at least one unhandled error event: rum.error.handled is false or the attribute is absent. Handled errors do not degrade session health. crash_free_rate is the fraction of crash-free sessions in the aggregate window, and the window is always bounded by the query.

release.description: Release dimension (resource attribute service.version); empty means the sessions carried no release.

crashed_sessions.description: Sessions carrying at least one unhandled error event.

crash_free_sessions.description: Sessions without any unhandled error event.

error_events.description: Error events observed in the aggregate's sessions, handled or not.
